# Sarah Cruz

> Creative Director, design consultant, designer and illustrator. More than 25 years of brand strategy, brand identity and packaging design, with a speciality in wine and spirits. Co-founder of Abundance London and co-creator of the Chiswick Timeline. Makes cut paper pet portraits.

Site: https://sarah-cruz.designer.sovereignweb.site
Source: https://github.com/SovereignWebsite/Site__Designer__Sarah-Cruz
Facts here come from Sarah's own portfolio (July 2024), her LinkedIn posts and public sources. Nothing is invented.

## About

"I have 25+ years experience in Brand Strategy, Brand Identity, Packaging and much more." Most recently Sarah specialised in wine and spirits design as Creative Director of Barlow & Co.
"I have been fortunate enough to spend most of my career designing on an almost daily basis so I would class myself as prolific. I'm not ready to hang up my pencil but I am open to roles in which I can advise strategically, mentor and direct the design process in an innovative, effective and agile way. I especially enjoy mentoring young designers."
"For over 10 years I have founded and led several local projects committed to improving our community in West London. I believe passionately in giving back to the community."

Roles: Creative Director, Barlow & Co; Formerly at Lewis Moberly; Co-founder, Abundance London; Co-creator, The Chiswick Timeline; Graphic designer, Chiswick Cheese Market; West London

## Work

### Packaging design
- Royal Ascot × Tisserand: Limited edition range for Royal Ascot inspired by the colourful racing silks as the horses flash by. Her part: Concept, Label design, Illustration.
- Honey I'm Home!: Celebrating our love of dogs by bringing Honey the Dog to life. Her part: Packaging design, Character creation, Illustration. Award: DBA Design Effectiveness Awards winner.
- Divino: Divinely different Italian gelato dessert comes to the UK. Her part: Packaging design, Icon design. Award: Pentawards winner.
- Fwip: Bringing to life a new brand of mini ice cream parlour machines. Her part: Brand naming, Logo design, Brand identity, Packaging.
- Trust Water for The Drinks Trust: The Drinks Trust is a charity dedicated to the drinks and hospitality workforce. Our water brand supported their work. Her part: Label design, Illustration.
- Superdrug B.: Re-styling Superdrug's range of cosmetics. Her part: Packaging design.

### Independent brands
- McGuigan Zero: Proudly introducing innovation to the UK. Now the UK's number 1 alcohol free wine. Her part: Strategy, Brand creation, Label design, Range extension.
- Maid of Bruton: Medieval Bruton, Somerset made new. By Durslade Vineyard and the people behind the art world of Hauser & Wirth. Created at Barlow & Co for the very first wine from Durslade Farm Vineyard. The vineyard sits on the site of an ancient Roman vine terrace where a Roman coin was found, inscribed with a woman holding a cornucopia of grapes. The label is a medieval interpretation of that maid, treading and eating grapes with a mischievous look in her eye. Her part: Brand creation, Label design, Illustration.
- Identity: Bringing to life the embodiment of a South African winery through illustration and augmented reality. Her part: Brand world, Brand identity, Label design, Illustration.
- PepperBox: Creating a brand that is all about being the perfect partner for great food. Her part: Brand creation, Label design, Illustration.
- Vina Laguna: Successfully bringing Croatian wine to the UK with great style and storytelling. Her part: Brand creation, Label design, Illustration, Tiering. Award: DBA Design Effectiveness Awards winner.
- Ashdown: Showing the world the beauty of English winemaking next to the Ashdown Forest. Her part: Brand creation, Label design, Illustration.
- Pol Roger canned wine: Champagne house Pol Roger makes a bold venture into UK canned wines. Her part: Naming, Brand creation, Packaging design.
- Genetie: Blending history and modernity in Burgundy. Her part: Brand world, Brand identity, Label design, Illustration.
- Valdivieso: Historic Chilean wine brand gets a refresh. Her part: Label design, Range extension, Tiering.
- And many more: Here are some other lovely wine labels I have had the pleasure and privilege to design. Her part: .

### Retailer exclusives
- M&S Found: The M&S Found range set the stage for the idea and look of wine discovery ranges in retail. Her part: Naming, Brand creation, Label design, Range extension. Award: The Drinks Business Awards 2022.
- M&S premium wines: M&S upping the game in its premium wine offering. Her part: Brand creation, Label design.
- Tesco core range: Redeveloping Tesco's core range of wines. Creating their new look and brand identities. Her part: Design direction, Naming, Label design of many wines.
- Tesco Finest: Tesco Finest range of 80+ wines. Telling stories of place and producer. Her part: Design direction, Brand identity, Label design of many wines. Award: Harpers Design Awards 2023, Silver.
- Wairau Cove: A new look for one of Tesco's most popular wine brands. Her part: Brand world, Brand identity, Label design.
- The Wine Society own brand: Refreshing the Wine Society's own brand range. Her part: Label design, Range extension. Award: Harpers Design Awards 2023, Best Redesign.
- The Wine Society Generation Series: Creating the Generation Series using a 'Vineline' to depict The Wine Society's 150-year history. Her part: Label design, Range extension, Collage illustration.
- Spar varietals: Spar's varietal range takes inspiration from letterpress type. Her part: Label design, Range extension.

### Spirits
- Warner Edwards: Rebranding of Warner Edwards led to triple digit growth. Her part: Brand strategy, Label design, Structure, Range extension. Award: DBA Design Effectiveness Awards winner.
- Glenmorangie: Radical repositioning of a niche scotch whisky into an LVMH luxury brand. Her part: Brand strategy, Icon creation, Label design, Range extension. Award: Wine and spirit design awards: winner, gold and silver.
- Johnnie Walker Directors Blend: Limited edition numbered screenprints for Johnnie Walker's exclusive Directors Blend. Her part: Concept, Label design, Illustration, Range extension.
- Snaps & Rye: Snaps & Rye introduce interesting flavoured snaps liqueur to the UK. Her part: Concept, Label design.

### Corporate identity
- Gatwick: Engaging narrative and informal logo was designed to connect to passengers on a personal level. Her part: Branding concept, Copywriting, Identity design.
- Monoprix: Beloved French retailer gets a refresh and a new engaging icon. Her part: Logo concept, Identity design.
- Weatherbys: Redesigning a 250 year old company at the heart of British horse racing. The previous logo was based on a Stubbs oil painting. Her part: Identity design.

### Also
- Also: a redesign of Terra Nostra for Bel Portugal, a famous Portuguese national brand, made with colleagues at Lewis Moberly, which included meetings in the Azores.

## The Chiswick Timeline

The Timeline is created from 16 enormous maps of the area, dating from 1592 to today, overlaid with works of art by renowned artists showing local landmarks. This includes two specially commissioned artworks by Sir Peter Blake and Jan Pienkowski.
The legacy of the mural includes the upgrade to the surrounding area, the creation of a local artist's trail and writer's trail, educational tours and even council right-of-way decisions. "I love to bring history to a new audience through design."
Sarah is the co-founder and was co-director of Abundance London from 2010 to 2020, a voluntary organisation in Chiswick that harvests surplus fruit and plants orchards, hedgerows and gardens, and creates beautiful spaces through planting and through art.
Her part: Co-creator, Map timeline concept, Research, Fundraising, Mural design, Artwork and production, Launch event, Merchandise, Associated projects.
Website: https://chiswicktimeline.org/

## Cut paper portraits

"Instead of making sourdough during lockdown I decided to do animal portrait collages made from cut and torn paper."
The portraits are all hand made using only cut paper, and can include personalised memorabilia within them. Sarah is open to commissions: see cruzandcruz.co.uk.

## Butternut Box concept

A creative task set while interviewing for the in-house role of Head of Creative at Butternut Box. Sarah spent a day on it. The insight: fresh dog food smells as good as it tastes, yet no one was communicating smell until the box arrived. This is interview work, not a commissioned campaign.

## Contact

For creative direction, design consultancy, mentoring or a cut paper portrait commission, find Sarah on LinkedIn or through Cruz & Cruz.
